description: float32 bit pattern to bfloat16 with round to nearest even and NaN quieting
notes: Real-world ML idiom (float32 to bfloat16 conversion in ML runtimes): round to nearest even by adding 0x7fff plus the lowest kept bit, NaN quieted by setting bit 6 of the result, no denormal flush; integers only (bit patterns). Function written by us. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake keeps the NaN test as a branch: 16 IR instructions. Whether a branchless form is better is unknown.
